FacilityId.description: The unique identifier for the facility.

ReportId.description: The unique identifier for the report (e.g., ReportScheduleId).

PatientId.description: The unique identifier for the patient (optional, for patient-specific updates).

Service.description: The name of the service reporting the status.

IsSuccess.description: Boolean indicating if the stage was completed successfully.

ProcessingTime.description: The time taken (in milliseconds) to complete the reported phase.

ErrorMessage.description: Detailed error message if IsSuccess is false.

CorrelationId.description: For tracing the request across services.
